title: Round 7 — d472033c: R3 fixes + merge with main (#12868 provider controls)
subtitle: Fresh bundle and Spring jar built from d472033c; MySQL 8.4.11. Same rig as rounds 1-6: Hosted Harness -> Java Broker/SQL -> Runtime worker -> stdio, Streamable HTTP and SSE MCP servers.

notes.text: No correctness blocker. Everything I checked in earlier rounds still holds, and the new busy-owner cleanup releases only the refused Session's incomplete acquisition, never the holder's lease.

title: Round 7 — behaviour for the maintainers to accept or change
subtitle: Same rig and head. None of these is a correctness failure; they are lifecycle choices that operators will see.
lines: ## A raw resource_read that never answers (server with the default timeoutMs)
!! at 4 s and at 61 s: op status 409, op cancel 409 hosted_mcp_operation_active, prompt 409, detach 409 hosted_turn_active
!! only GET /status answers; the client cannot cancel or detach until the operation ends (not measured to the end)
== round 5 answered the same cancel with 202 running; the fence is intentional ("serialize close/status/cancel")
## Harness exits while an MCP Session is attached (no detach)
!! the Workspace lease stays held with no TTL; the runtime Session is still READY
++ recoverable: load in a new Harness 200 -> turn OK -> detach 204 -> lease 0   (related to the open R3-11 thread)
## Unchanged documented limits
== N1 no reply possible: turn active until 633 s (UNKNOWN from 36.5 s), then blocked; detach 503, lease held
== worker SIGKILL during a call: blocked after 4.9 s; detach 503, lease held
== F1: an MCP Session holds the Workspace between turns (other MCP Session 503, files Session turn_error)
== exactly 16 pins + one list_changed: later turns fail until detach + load (15 pins recover)
== Flyway: main V18, this PR V21, #12894 (open) V19/V20 -> merge #12894 first or renumber
## Test stability, local (load 11-20)
!! hosted-harness-session.test.ts: 6 of 8 full-file runs green; the 2 failures hit different tests
!!    (waitFor timeout in the R1-2 test; load 404 in the create/load test); each passed in the other 7 runs; CI green

notes.text: The hung-operation fence and the orphan lease are the two items worth an explicit decision: each leaves a Session or Workspace unusable until a timeout ends the operation, or until someone loads the Session again and detaches it.
